Range requests

+ * + *

The file server and {@linkplain #createFileHandler(Path) file handler} also support HTTP + * range requests, allowing clients to + * request partial file content using the {@code Range} request header, as specified in + * RFC 9110. + * Multiple ranges are sorted, and overlapping or adjacent ranges are merged. + * Requests containing an excessive number of ranges may be rejected.

+ * + *

Conditional range requests with the {@code If-Range} + * request header are not supported. If {@code If-Range} is present, + * the server ignores the {@code Range} request header and returns the entire file.
